parts.label: a
parts.text: Consider the smooth conic D \subset \mathbb{P}^2 given by x^2 + y^2 - z^2 = 0. Let \ell be the line with equation 2x - 3y + 7z = 0. Using the dual curve D^\vee, compute the value of the defining polynomial a^2 + b^2 - c^2 at the point (a,b,c) = (2, -3, 7). Round your final answer to 4 decimal places and place it inside \boxed{}.

parts.label: b
parts.text: Let x = your answer to part (a). Consider the finite étale morphism f : \mathbb{P}^1 \to \mathbb{P}^1 over \mathbb{Z} defined by f(t)=t^{|x|}, where |x| denotes the absolute value of x. Using the average fiber size theorem, determine the limiting average size of the fibers f^{-1}(y) as the prime p \to \infty. Round your final answer to 4 decimal places and place it inside \boxed{}.

parts.label: c
parts.text:
Let y = your answer to part (b). Using the correspondence between plane conics and symmetric 3\times 3 matrices, consider the symmetric matrix

M = \begin{pmatrix}
 y & 1 & 2 \\ 
 1 & 3 & 4 \\ 
 2 & 4 & 5 
\end{pmatrix}.

Compute the determinant of M (the determinant is an invariant of the conic up to scaling). Round your final answer to 4 decimal places and place it inside \boxed{}.

**Part (a)**  

Evaluate the polynomial \(a^{2}+b^{2}-c^{2}\) at \((a,b,c)=(2,-3,7)\):

\[
2^{2}+(-3)^{2}-7^{2}=4+9-49=-36 .
\]

\[
\boxed{-36.0000}
\]

---

**Part (b)**  

From part (a) we have \(x=-36.0000\), so \(|x|=36\).  
The morphism \(f:\mathbb{P}^{1}\to\mathbb{P}^{1}\) is given by \(f(t)=t^{36}\), a finite map of degree \(36\).  
The average‑fiber‑size theorem states that for a finite étale cover of degree \(d\) the average size of the fibers over \(\mathbb{F}_{p}\) tends to \(d\) as \(p\to\infty\). Hence the limiting average size is \(36\).

\[
\boxed{36.0000}
\]

---

**Part (c)**  

Now \(y=36.0000\).  Form the symmetric matrix  

\[
M=\begin{pmatrix}
36 & 1 & 2\\
1 & 3 & 4\\
2 & 4 & 5
\end{pmatrix}.
\]

Its determinant is  

\[
\begin{aligned}
\det M &= 36\begin{vmatrix}3&4\\4&5\end{vmatrix}
        -1\begin{vmatrix}1&4\\2&5\end{vmatrix}
        +2\begin{vmatrix}1&3\\2&4\end{vmatrix} \\[4pt]
      &= 36(3\cdot5-4\cdot4)-1(1\cdot5-4\cdot2)+2(1\cdot4-3\cdot2)\\
      &= 36(-1)-1(-3)+2(-2)\\
      &= -36+3-4 = -37 .
\end{aligned}
\]

\[
\boxed{-37.0000}
\]

---

**Part (a)**  

For the smooth conic \(D : x^{2}+y^{2}-z^{2}=0\) the dual conic \(D^{\vee}\) is given (up to a non‑zero scalar) by the same quadratic form in the dual coordinates \((a,b,c)\):
\[
a^{2}+b^{2}-c^{2}=0 .
\]

Evaluating this polynomial at the point \((a,b,c)=(2,-3,7)\):
\[
2^{2}+(-3)^{2}-7^{2}=4+9-49=-36 .
\]

\[
\boxed{-36.0000}
\]

---

**Part (b)**  

Let \(x\) be the answer from part (a); \(|x| = |-36| = 36\).  
The morphism is \(f(t)=t^{36}\colon \mathbb{P}^{1}\to\mathbb{P}^{1}\), a finite map of degree \(d=36\).

For a finite étale morphism of degree \(d\) the average size of the fibres over \(\mathbb{F}_{p}\)-points satisfies  

\[
\frac{|\mathbb{P}^{1}(\mathbb{F}_{p})|}{|\mathbb{P}^{1}(\mathbb{F}_{p})|}\;=\;d\quad\text{as }p\to\infty .
\]

Hence the limiting average fibre size is \(36\).

\[
\boxed{36.0000}
\]

---

**Part (c)**  

Take \(y = 36.0000\) from part (b) and form  

\[
M=\begin{pmatrix}
36 & 1 & 2\\[2pt]
1 & 3 & 4\\[2pt]
2 & 4 & 5
\end{pmatrix}.
\]

The determinant is  

\[
\begin{aligned}
\det M &= 36\bigl(3\cdot5-4\cdot4\bigr)-1\bigl(1\cdot5-4\cdot2\bigr)
        +2\bigl(1\cdot4-3\cdot2\bigr)\\
       &= 36(-1)-1(-3)+2(-2)\\
       &= -36+3-4 = -37 .
\end{aligned}
\]

\[
\boxed{-37.0000}
\]
